summary: Connect HR data governance, attrition analysis and workforce planning. Explore the people analytics course and strengthen your reporting practice.
lede: Workforce analytics training helps HR leaders and people analytics teams use governed employee data to inform staffing, skills and people-risk decisions. Participants practise defining consistent measures, analysing attrition and skills gaps, and creating dashboards and workforce scenarios. The syllabus also introduces CRISP-DM, logistic regression interpretation, responsible data use and presenting findings to leaders.
audienceIntro: This programme suits HR professionals who use workforce information to set priorities, advise business leaders or explain people-related risk. It is designed for practitioners with working familiarity with HR operations or workforce measures who want to connect data governance, analysis and planning.
modules: People Analytics Strategy and Operating Model
Excel and Power BI Workforce Analysis
Skills Gap Analysis and Capability Mapping
prerequisites: Working familiarity with HR operations, workforce measures or HR reporting is expected. No programming experience is required; Python basics appear in guided examples, and the course focuses on interpreting an introductory workflow rather than building production models.
